text:
Maya: small design check — working on docs-to-console alignment: thinking about showing the canonical docs term in the in-panel header and the Console label as an inline alias. Thoughts?

Chris: sounds good. prefer canonical docs term in headings so links/search match.

Sam: ok but we need fallback when doc metadata is missing. show Console label and a "Report mismatch" link.

Lee: accessibility: ensure alias line isn't the only place conveying meaning. Screen readers need the canonical term first with aria-label. Add skip link to TOC.

Nia: marketing ask: call it "In-product docs" in UI. Support still uses "Help panel" for a bit while we migrate.

Maya: plan: show heading = docs.preferred_label, subline = "Also known as: <Console label>" (clickable). deprecations show dim + "Deprecated" badge.

Chris: add telemetry: alias clicks, mismatch reports, and heading vs alias impression.

docs-bot: I'll run slug stability and emit a CSV mapping console_label->preferred_label->aliases within 24h.

Sam: UX nit: truncate alias lists after 2 items and show "+N more" with keyboard-accessible menu.

Lee: ensure contrast + focus styles. aria-current on active doc. announce changes when panel content updates.

Maya: I'll prototype in Figma and do a 7% canary with a11y checklist. will post link here.

Chris: :thumbsup:

Maya: thanks all — will follow up with copy variants for marketing/support.
